description: Canonical terms for the Valmet five-year ontology-backed LCA case study.

keywords.definition: In this case study, an Evidence Object stores concept type, canonical concept, value, unit, year, source file, page, quote, applicability, missing fields, audit flags and review status.

keywords.short: Information extraction governed by explicit ontology definitions and validation rules.
keywords.definition: Ontology extraction compiles a meta-ontology into domain and extraction ontologies, then converts source-grounded spans into Evidence Objects that can be audited and reused.

keywords.short: The operational schema for a particular extraction run.
keywords.definition: The extraction ontology defines target classes, fields, required grounding, validators and audit flags for one extraction task; here it projects LCA/GHG concepts onto Valmet 2018–2022 reports.

keywords.short: The stable professional concept map behind extraction.
keywords.definition: The domain ontology defines canonical GHG/LCA concepts such as Scope 1, Scope 2 location-based, Scope 3 Category 1, LCA claim, assurance and missing disclosures.

keywords.short: How usable a report is for corporate GHG inventory review.
keywords.definition: A readiness assessment for company-level GHG inventory and disclosure trend analysis. It does not imply product-level LCA readiness.

keywords.short: Whether evidence is sufficient for product-level LCA modelling.
keywords.definition: Product LCA readiness requires functional unit, product system boundary, foreground flows, allocation, method and source-grounded values. This Valmet case is rated low because those elements are missing.

keywords.short: Using Scope 3 category evidence to identify likely priority areas.
keywords.definition: The Valmet case uses Category 1/4/6/9 source-grounded rows to identify purchased goods and services as the dominant captured Scope 3 hotspot.

keywords.short: Audit flag for missing calculation-method detail.
keywords.definition: An audit flag indicating that a row has values and units but lacks enough emission-factor, activity-data or calculation-method detail for direct LCI reuse.

keywords.short: The quantified reference unit of a product LCA study.
keywords.definition: Functional unit defines the quantified performance basis for product LCA. The extracted Valmet LCA/use-phase claims do not provide a functional unit, which blocks product-LCA-ready interpretation.
